Good entertainment; bland food, poor service
Mar 2026 • Couples
Good entertainment; bland food, poor service. A mixed review here sadly. Although only 2 of us, we were served our main meals so far apart that one of us had nearly finished by the time the other one got any food. Added to that, we found the food quite bland tasting, and there were no condiments to be seen. The saving grace was the singer and entertainer Daniel. He is one high octane and fun 70 year old! Go there for the entertainment. If you find food you like, that's a bonus.

Very poor
Mar 2025 • Couples
We were looking forward to our visit as we really enjoyed Korean BBQ and place looked busy which can be a good sign. Sadly this was a mistake, a big one. First off seemed ok and got a menu quite quickly but then getting a drink took longer. When draft beer arrived it, quite simply, vile. Either off, flat, watered down or a mixture of the 3, so we sent back BUT WERE STILL CHARGED FOR IT! 

We ordered most expensive dish on menu of a meat and fish platter and when it arrived it looked good. To be fair the fish and shellfish was good (the only reason the rating is not 1 Star) the meat however was exceptionally poor quality - basically fat, gristle and rubber texture. 

I cook BBQ for large parties on a regular basis and had cooked all items correctly.
